title: Clause serialization length bound
statement: For every clause $C$ of natural-number-indexed literals, the length of its binary serialization is at least the number of literal occurrences in $C$ plus one.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a clause of natural-number-indexed literals
replaced:
For every clause $C$, the serialization of $C$ has length at least $|C| + 1$,
where $|C|$ counts literal occurrences: there is room for every literal and the
terminator.
